input.original_instruction: For your start point you are in a bedroom, you will need to exit this bedroom by moving past the bed that is on your right. pass the chest that is o your left and the dresser that is on your right until you reach the doorway or archway. Once you are there turn right through the open doorway. Move into the  hall  and turn left and go down the stairs. Once you are down the stairs you will be in a foyer to the right you will see the front door that is open. And turning back straight a head you will see a console table to your left that has a mirror and a umbrella stand to your right. Move forward until you are in the middle of the doorway that leads into a living room, once you are there do not move. You have reached your end point in between the doorway leading into the living room.
